events.body:
## Outcome

Make discovery signals portable signed objects whose visibility and trusted indexes are chosen by each user.

## Implementation

- Define star, watch, bookmark, follow, recommend, mirror, production-use, and security-review assertion events.
- Include subject identity, optional evidence, visibility scope, creation, expiry, and undo references in the signed schema.
- Derive watch notifications and aggregate counts through deterministic folds without treating popularity as trust.
- Allow private local bookmarks, shared assertions, portable export and import, and user-selected trusted index sources.
- Deduplicate replayed events and preserve conflicting independent opinions.

## Acceptance criteria

- Undo and expiry remove an assertion from current state without erasing history.
- Private assertions never enter public catalog or notification payloads.
- Imported assertions retain original signatures and source provenance.
- Index selection changes aggregation without changing the underlying records.
- Shuffled and duplicated event sets converge across clients.

## Dependencies

Uses convergence rules from #440 and identity scopes from #447.

## Verification

Run every assertion, visibility, evidence, expiry, undo, import, duplicate, conflicting-opinion, trusted-index, and derived-notification fixture through all folds and renderers.
